items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: So anyway, Ken Peplowski, who I work with a lot, also played for a polka band

ctx.x: So anyway, Ken Peplowski, who I work with a lot, also played for a polka band out in the Cleveland, Ohio area. He cut his chops, got going with that fast clarinet playing from playing polkas. That’s what got him into it anyway.
It serves you well I think, technique-wise at least.
